responseMessageContents.text:
The **17 items are not 17 separate Render tasks**. They are 17 GitHub commits waiting behind **one build blocker**: `backend/services/ivx-ses-email.ts` is encoded incorrectly in commit `edf62a9`, so Render cannot start the app.

### Waiting deployment commits, in order
1. `bf455df2911` — Payment API  
2. `597110123944` — Payment infrastructure tests  
3. `c5b150c9ad82` — Payment database migration  
4. `1fa3f900610f` — Payment API client  
5. `622c98d20f4f` — Participate Now screen  
6. `719a2b248e87` — Payments screen  
7. `33aada6f80ac` — Payment routes connected to backend  
8. `c92ed7898e53` — Stripe dependency  
9. `2e6839e399a0` — Tokenized participation page  
10. `f1ce667e9a98` — JV application page  
11. `5916259d0f46` — Buyer offer page  
12. `ea70515e5253` — Payment routes re-push  
13. `5aed8d0f3285` — Stripe dependency re-push  
14. `04f382934830` — Payment routes update  
15. `4c04da59539a` — Stripe dependency update  
16. `a9583018f305` — SES SMTP support  
17. `edf62a9f4940` — SES deploy-trigger commit — **this is the commit Render tried and failed to build**

### Current Render status
- **Blocked by:** `ivx-ses-email.ts: Unexpected end of file`
- **Reason:** the GitHub copy is a Base64 blob, not valid TypeScript.
- **Do not redeploy:** `edf62a9`; it will fail every time.
- **Auto-Deploy:** correctly enabled as **On Commit**.

### What happens next
A corrected replacement for that file must reach GitHub as a **new commit**. Then Render will automatically build that new SHA, and it will include all 17 waiting commits together. There is no need to deploy them one by one.
